summary: The migration plan a1-rename-note-001 ran three stages—expand, backfill, and deploy_new—successfully, taking a total of ~19 seconds. However, it did not complete all stages and was halted. The halt occurred at the contract stage "contract-drop-old-column" because the system detected that the old application was still running, preventing the column drop. No explicit check failures were reported, though the retirement_gate check is listed without details.
suspected_cause: Old application still running, causing the contract-drop-old-column stage to refuse the column removal.
